rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: React #418 hydration mismatch was caused by using hydrateRoot with prerendered HTML that had subtle mismatches (CmsAdminLayer Suspense, Routes Suspense, NavDropdown Link, and Navbar scroll state). After 8 iterations of targeted fixes, the pragmatic solution was switching from hydrateRoot to createRoot in index.js, which does a fresh client-side render without any reconciliation against prerendered HTML — eliminating all possible #418 errors.
rca_of_the_issue.fix: index.js: replaced hydrateRoot with createRoot. Prerendered HTML still served for SEO/LCP but React renders from scratch.
